name: JAC Japan map 15 km (historical): 1534 relations, feud opinion penalty (-10, both ways), Shimazu-Ryukyu friendship

steps.code: local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; for _,f in ipairs({'OUCHI','OTOMO','HOJO','IMAGAWA','MORI','DATE','ASHINA','ASHIKAGA','ROKKAKU','TAKEDA','ODA','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU','NAGAO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI','MATSUDAIRA','HONGANJI'}) do if id[f]==nil then error('missing faction '..f) end end; local function st(a,b) return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(id[b])].StateType end; local function war(a,b) return Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(id[b]) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(id[b]); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end;  local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_JAPAN_1534_RELATIONS'); if s==nil then error('relations property missing') end; if s.Applied~=16 or s.Failed~=0 or s.Missing~=0 then error('applied='..tostring(s.Applied)..' failed='..tostring(s.Failed)..' missing='..tostring(s.Missing)) end; if s.Turn~=GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() then error('applied on turn '..tostring(s.Turn)) end; if not war('OUCHI','OTOMO') or not war('OTOMO','OUCHI') then error('R01 Ouchi-Otomo not at war') end; for _,pair in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'OUCHI','MORI'},{'DATE','ASHINA'},{'ASHIKAGA','ROKKAKU'},{'SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}}) do for _,d in ipairs({{pair[1],pair[2]},{pair[2],pair[1]}}) do local s=st(d[1],d[2]); if s~='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error(d[1]..'->'..d[2]..' state '..tostring(s)) end end end; for _,pair in ipairs({{'HOJO','TAKEDA'},{'IMAGAWA','TAKEDA'},{'HOJO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI'},{'NAGAO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI'},{'NAGAO','HONGANJI'},{'HONGANJI','ROKKAKU'},{'ODA','MATSUDAIRA'}}) do for _,dd in ipairs({{pair[1],pair[2]},{pair[2],pair[1]}}) do if feud(dd[1],dd[2])~=-10 then error(dd[1]..'->'..dd[2]..' feud penalty '..tostring(feud(dd[1],dd[2]))..' (expected -10)') end end end; if war('HOJO','TAKEDA') or st('HOJO','TAKEDA')=='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error('feud pair Hojo-Takeda must be neither at war nor friends') end; if feud('ODA','DATE')~=0 or feud('SHIMAZU','RYUKYU')~=0 then error('unrelated or friendly pair has a feud penalty') end; if war('ODA','DATE') then error('unrelated pair Oda-Date at war') end; return 'start: 16 relations applied on the start turn; Ouchi-Otomo war; Hojo-Imagawa, Ouchi-Mori, Date-Ashina, Ashikaga-Rokkaku, Shimazu-Ryukyu declared friends; 7 feud pairs show -10 both ways and stay at peace'

(expected -10)') end end end; if war('HOJO','TAKEDA') or st('HOJO','TAKEDA')=='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error('feud pair Hojo-Takeda must be neither at war nor friends') end; if feud('ODA','DATE')~=0 or feud('SHIMAZU','RYUKYU')~=0 then error('unrelated or friendly pair has a feud penalty') end; if war('ODA','DATE') then error('unrelated pair Oda-Date at war') end; return 'after 1 turn: relations and feud penalties still hold'
